content: Me Yudia tubudiyao ꞌidi bubuna
Muliyega Palisiyao be loina ꞌana toeꞌitao Yelusalemega simai Yesu ꞌena, ga sieonena, sigwae,
“Toꞌase manuna ꞌimu tononoyao ꞌabo ꞌeꞌai mulinaya nigeya nimadi sida ꞌutudi, nate tubudao ꞌidi loina sileꞌoaleꞌoa?”
Ta ꞌieonedi, “ꞌOmi wate Yaubada ꞌina loina waleꞌoaleꞌoa, manuna tubumiyao ꞌidi bubuna wamulimuliyedi.
Yaubada ꞌina loina ꞌeluwa getedi: ꞌebweuna ꞌigwae, ‘Tamayo be sinayo ꞌuda ꞌamayabedi’, ta ꞌeluwena wate ꞌigwae, ‘ꞌEguma yaita tamana nai sinana ꞌiꞌawa toꞌumaliyedi, ꞌilobwenena be waloemwawasi.’

Ta ꞌomi ꞌimi eꞌita kabokabo, wagwae, ‘ꞌEguma yaita tamana be sinana ꞌieonadi, ꞌigwae, “ꞌIgu gwegweyao niꞌatu yatagwaledi Yaubada ꞌenaya, ꞌenega nigeya sawesaweguya be yalememi” ’, ꞌenega ꞌimi nuwanuwa ꞌaene tai nina ꞌina lema nai ꞌina ꞌamayaba tamana ꞌenaya nigeya yage sinabwana.
Tubumiyao ꞌidi loina gete ꞌenega Yaubada ꞌina loina waeyage besobesoena.
“Onaꞌaiꞌaila ꞌomi tokabokabo. Lowaenei Aisea palopita manumi ꞌionaupaupa ꞌaiꞌaila, tuta nina Yaubada ꞌina ona ꞌisimanena, ꞌigwae,
‘Tomota getedi ꞌawadiyega siꞌamaꞌamayabegu ta ꞌatediyega nigeya,
ta wate ꞌeguya sitapwalolo besobeso, manuna ꞌidi eꞌitao ꞌaboꞌagu nigeya ꞌeguyega, ta esi tomota tuga ꞌidi nuwenuwega.’”
ꞌEnega tomota ꞌibwauyedima ga ꞌieonedi, “Ona gete wanono be wada mwalatoni ꞌaene
masula nidi ꞌawadega silugulugu nigeya sawesawenaya be sigiegie bailida ta esi ona nidi ꞌawadega siapweapwesama taudi esiya sigiebailida.”
ꞌEnega ꞌina tononoyao Yesu ꞌena simai ga sieonena, “ꞌInapwana, ꞌunonona ꞌaene Palisiyao ꞌimu ona gete manuna niꞌatu sinuwa mwau.”
Ta Yesu ꞌigwae, “Kaiwe nidi Tamagu nigeya ꞌiasoasodi, maꞌetamo ꞌidabu yauledi.
Ta tuwa tuga, Palisiyao nidi sida miyami ꞌana laba sibebeꞌu, manuna taudi toanuganao matakebokebodi, be ꞌeguma gosediyao matakebokebodi sianuganedi, ꞌiabe maiboꞌadi gaulaya sibebeꞌu.”
ꞌEnega Pita ꞌilolagata ga ꞌigwae, “Onasemalimali gete ꞌana mwalatoi ꞌuda liꞌami ꞌemaya.”
Ta Yesu ꞌigwae, “Nai ꞌomi wate ꞌetamo nuwami nigeya ꞌisabwasabwalena,
ꞌenega nigeya wamwalamwalatoni ꞌaene toꞌase ꞌawadega ꞌilugulugu gamwadaya ꞌitatauya, be muliyega ꞌitatauya sumwana ꞌenaya.
Ta esi toꞌase tomota ꞌawadiyega siapweapwesama nate ꞌatediyega simeema ta sigiegie bailidi,
nate nuwanuwa toꞌumalidi be loemwawasa be loelata be sogala be ꞌipwala be onakabokabo be sinala be.
Yage getedi ꞌediyega tomota ꞌigiegie bailidi, ta ꞌabo nimada geyaꞌabo taꞌutuꞌutudi tuta ꞌeꞌai ꞌenaya, nate yaluyaluwada geyaꞌabo ꞌigiegie baili.”
Kenani wainena ꞌina emisa
ꞌEnega Yesu sena nina ꞌipilisinena ga ꞌitauya Taiya be Saidoni senadiyao ꞌediya.

Ta sena nina ꞌenega Kenani wainena ꞌebweu ꞌiapwesa ga Yesu ꞌieonena, ꞌigwae, “ꞌInapwana, ꞌoyo Debida ꞌina susu, ꞌuda ꞌatenuwa ꞌoleꞌoleyegu, manuna natugu mewainena niꞌatu yaluyaluwa biꞌi ꞌigiekabaleyena,”
Ta Yesu waine nina ꞌina bwau nigeya ꞌieꞌieꞌisa, ꞌenega ꞌina tononoyao simai ga Yesu sisidena, sigwae, “Waine nina ꞌueꞌidiꞌidiye be ꞌitatauya, manuna ꞌibwaubwau wawasae.”
Ta Yesu ꞌigwae, “ꞌAboꞌagu yamai sipi kwanikwanidi Isileli namo ꞌina ꞌebeloina solanaya manudi.”
Ta esi waine nina ꞌimai ga Yesu matanaya ꞌiꞌaetulasa, ta ꞌigwae, “ꞌInapwana ꞌuda lemegu.”
Ta Yesu ꞌiona, “Nigeya sawesawenaya be gogama ꞌadi masula yaꞌebwaya kedewa ꞌediya.”
Ta waine nina ꞌigwae, “ꞌInapwana, nate onaꞌaiꞌaila. Ta mwaꞌadega masula mugumuguna ꞌabo sibebeꞌu ꞌinapwana ꞌina ꞌebe ꞌeꞌai ꞌenega, sawesawenaya be ꞌina kedewao siꞌaꞌani?”
ꞌEnega Yesu waine ꞌina ona nina ꞌieꞌisena, ꞌigwae, “Waine, ꞌoyo saꞌi toemisa ꞌaiꞌaila. ꞌEnega gete tuga ꞌimu emisa nina uwana ꞌida apwesa.” Ta tuta gote ꞌenaya waine nina natuna ꞌiboboꞌana limana.
Toleꞌoasao yaudi ꞌigieboboꞌanedi
ꞌEnega Yesu sena nina ꞌipilisinena ga ꞌiawadawadaꞌe Galili olana leꞌawinega, ga ꞌoyaya ꞌituꞌe, ga nada ꞌimiyatowa.

Ta boda sinabwana silagama ga ꞌidi toleꞌoasao simeꞌedi, taudi tolopegoi be, taudi esilae ꞌediyega sinenetaya be, tomata kebokeboyao be, toekabaleyao be ꞌaidi toleꞌoasao wate Yesu selabenaya sisaꞌudi ga ꞌigieboboꞌanedi.

ꞌEnega pwalu nidi siꞌitedi toekabaleya sionaona be sinonono, be taudi esilae ꞌediyega sinenetaya siboboꞌana limana, be tolopegoi sitautauya palupalu, be tomata kebokebo matadi siꞌesasedi. ꞌEnega boda nidi sinuwa owana, ga me Isileli ꞌidi Yaubada nina situpuna.
Yesu pwalu ꞌieꞌenidi

ꞌEnega Yesu ꞌina tononoyao ꞌibwauyedima ga ꞌieonedi, “Boda getedi yaꞌatenuwa ꞌoleꞌoleyedi, manuna niꞌatu ꞌasiyata ꞌetoi bada maꞌegwao ꞌamiyami ta nigeya ꞌadi masulamo, ta geya nuwagu be mabotanidi yaetune iledi ꞌabona nai ꞌedaya sitatai.”
Ta ꞌina tononoyao sieonena, sigwae, “Sena getei mwatui daita, ta mwaꞌadega pwalu sinabwana getei ꞌadi masula talobaꞌese?”
ꞌEnega Yesu ꞌienaidedi, ꞌigwae, “ꞌEisa ꞌami belediyao simiyami?” Ga sigwae, “Beledi sebeni ta ꞌaina iyana gidalidi.”
ꞌEnega boda ꞌiloinedi ga baleꞌuya simiyatowa.
Ga beledi sebeni be iyana nidi ꞌiꞌewedi ga manudi ꞌiona lokagutoki Yaubada ꞌena ga ꞌigitomwedi, ta ꞌiꞌebwaꞌedi ꞌina tononoyao ꞌediya, ga taudi sieguyaiyedi boda nidi ꞌediya.
Ta maiboꞌadi siꞌai ga gamwadi ꞌipawa, ga muliyega masula tupwatupwadi siegogonedi ga kodo sebeni siloemaedi.
Toꞌeꞌai nidi tai dimo ꞌadi yau powa tausani, ta wate iine be gogama yaudi nigeya sisawasawadi.
Muliyega pwalu ꞌietunedi ga siila limana, ta Yesu wagaya ꞌigelu, ga Magadani senanaya ꞌitauya.
